summary: Explains includes don't inherit tags by default; to get inheritance on an include without switching to imports, use the apply keyword or wrap the include in a tagged block.
questions: How do I make tags on include_tasks apply to the included tasks?
What does the apply keyword do on include_tasks?
Can I get tag inheritance without using import_tasks?

answer_card.title: Tag inheritance for includes: apply and blocks
answer_card.answer_md:
Includes don't pass tags down. Imports do, but mixing imports and includes causes bugs, so use either:

```yaml
- include_tasks:
    file: db.yml
    apply:
      tags: db   # tags tasks inside db.yml
  tags: db       # tags the include itself
```

or a block:

```yaml
- block:
   - include_tasks: db.yml
  tags: db
```
